problem_type: Windows local validation paths and process arguments are assembled with POSIX-only or shell-dependent semantics
symptom: Windows validation can resolve file URLs as /C:/ paths, split Vitest filters containing spaces, or omit the isolated profile directory from credential prechecks
direct_cause: Several callers read URL.pathname as a filesystem path and vitest-fair-share delegated argv construction to a Windows shell
class_root: The repository had no shared invariant requiring fileURLToPath for filesystem paths or direct Node argv execution for local gates
affected_population: Windows developers running local gates and focused Vitest filters
Node tests and design evidence scripts that resolve files relative to import.meta.url
internal_only_reason: The invariant is repository-owned local validation behavior; no provider or external service controls it.
invariants: Filesystem paths derived from import.meta.url use fileURLToPath
Vitest receives one argv item per user argument without shell parsing
Credential precheck subprocesses receive an isolated absolute NOMI_REAL_PROFILE_USER_DATA directory

door_reduction.why_not: The launcher construction and local Vitest resolution are separate responsibilities and both must remain explicit entry points.

generality_proof: All changed URL-relative filesystem callers now pass through fileURLToPath, and every fair-share launch uses the same direct-process invocation builder; the lint selector blocks new URL pathname filesystem conversions in linted source files.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Reject URL.pathname filesystem path conversions in linted source.
Build a platform-independent argv vector with shell disabled.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Gate scripts remain in the documented temporary allowlist; their four existing conversions are tracked for a follow-up migration.
Both test root calculations now use fileURLToPath.
The output directory now comes from fileURLToPath(new URL(...)).

recurrence.reason: The same URL pathname and shell argv mechanisms exist in multiple scripts and can recur whenever a new Windows path or spaced filter is added.
same_class_scan: rg new URL(... import.meta.url).pathname found 11 occurrences before the fix; four gate-script occurrences remain in the temporary allowlist.
rg shell: true scripts/vitest-fair-share.mjs identified the process boundary that split spaced arguments.
scripts/vitest-fair-share.node-test.mjs now tests a spaced filter as one argv item.

prevention.invariant: L linted code cannot use new URL(...).pathname as a filesystem path.
prevention.failure_mode: ESLint reports an error directing callers to node:url fileURLToPath.
prevention.strategy: Enforce the class at lint time and centralize Vitest argv construction in the launcher.

legacy_paths.rationale: No persisted data or obsolete runtime path is migrated; this changes local validation path and argv construction only.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Node and Vitest remain the supported local runtime; no dependency upgrade is required for the invariant.

migration: No stored data migration is needed. Gate scripts in the temporary allowlist must be migrated before the allowlist is removed.
residual_risks: Four check scripts still contain URL.pathname conversions and are explicitly unverified until their gate-source migration.
